name: Folders
description: Copy a folder of this Mac into a sandbox, such as ~/.agents with its skills, links kept. Login files, history and caches are left out.

actions.label: Copy a folder in
actions.description: Copies a folder in your home into the sandbox, by default to the same place under the sandbox user's home. Copying it again updates it. Anything running in the sandbox can read the copy. It copies into sandboxes on this Mac only.

fields.label: Into, in the sandbox (blank: the same place)
Replace files Asidee did not copy

actions.label: Remove a copied folder
actions.description: Removes only the files and links Asidee copied there; anything else in that folder stays.
